title: Deterministic presentation table renderer v1 — artifact families (descriptive_facts / diagnostics / model_registry)
source_of_truth: tests/fixtures/artifacts/valid/ (existing synthetic artifact bundle; scientific numbers obtained from descriptive_facts.json / diagnostics.json / model_registry.json, not hard-coded)
scope: deterministic derived-view table rendering from each family artifact with explicit item_id references. Descriptive-facts fields: fact_id/name/value/unit/sample_id. Diagnostics fields: diagnostic_id/name/value/method/model_id. Model-registry fields: model_id/capability_id/implementation_id/runtime/sample_id/outcome/specification/fixed_effects/vcov_spec/clustering/n. Does NOT cover generic tables, estimate tables, figures, or a general summary-statistics matrix.
gate: full artifact-bundle validation (core validateArtifacts: scientific artifact structure + estimates<->model_registry + replication_stamp consistency + artifact_manifest canonical hashes + presentation provenance binding/source_hash)

cases.A: determinism for each family (render twice -> identical bytes)
cases.B: source fidelity per family (rendered row equals referenced values from the family artifact)
cases.C: upstream change propagation per family (modify source artifact -> old binding fails; rebuild full provenance chain -> renders, output reflects change)
cases.D: explicit scope / stale item_id / missing family view -> render FAIL (no cross-family bleed)

no_op: does NOT promote any implementation to verified; tested promotion is justified by this synthetic/adversarial evidence PLUS genuine non-synthetic Grunfeld real-data family views
